bio_draft: Rafiki is the DJ and producer alias of Sohail Arora, founder of the Mumbai events and artist management company Krunk and its label Krunk Kulture. Based in Mumbai, he plays acid, breaks, house and techno, has played Magnetic Fields and NH7 Weekender, and has released on Welt Discos, Permanent Vacation and Krunk Kulture.
